messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] kv-cache surge detected on cluster 'us-west-2-prod' (mistral-qwen-mqa route). CPU/GPU backpressure rising, error rate spike.

Sam T: paging oncall @oncall-bot - seeing kv eviction + cont-batch growth, affecting qwen-mqa and mistral-gqa traffic. latency up ~3x for some keys :warning:

Li Chen: looking. can you confirm which shard? logs show eviction_rate spiking on shard-7 and shard-12

Maria Gomez: customers A & B reported 429s and timeouts, SLOs breached. ETA to mitigation?

Taylor Nguyen: I can flip batching config to emergency safe mode. propose: disable continuous batching (cont_batch.enabled=false) + reduce max_batch_size from 1024 to 256 and set kv.prefetch_window=0.2

Rohit Patel: +1 to disable cont-batch. also throttle prefetch to avoid cache blowout. I'm preparing a CLI patch.

Sam T: do it, and create canary to 10% of traffic first. we want minimal impact.

Rohit Patel: running:
```bash
rhctl apply patch --cluster us-west-2-prod --file - <<'YAML'
cont_batch:
  enabled: false
  max_batch_size: 256
kv:
  prefetch_window: 0.2
  max_entries_per_shard: 400000
YAML
```

oncall-bot: acknowledged by @Rohit Patel. Config patch applied to shard-7 canary (10%) at 2071234680.

Li Chen: canary metrics: latency down 35% for canary, eviction_rate stabilized from 1200/s to 150/s. no errors yet.

Maria Gomez: customers on canary report latency normalized. starting gradual rollout.

Rohit Patel: rolling patch to remaining shards (batch size enforcement + prefetch throttle). command:
```bash
rhctl rollout config cont_batch.enabled=false --selector=kv-shard
```

incident-bot: rollout 30% at 2071234785, 60% at 2071234845, 100% at 2071234910

Sam T: good. need postmortem checklist: root cause hypothesis = cont-batch change + new prefetch algorithm in 2026.02 caused cache population to grow unbounded for certain high-cardinality prefixes on qwen-mqa. we should add guard rails.

Taylor Nguyen: noted. action items:
- revert prefetch behavior for MQA routes
- add eviction cap per-prefix
- add circuit-breaker for cont-batch on high eviction rate

Li Chen: I'll draft the hotfix RFC and put it into eng-runtime backlog. will also schedule a regression test comparing GQA/MQA prefix distributions.

Maria Gomez: customer impact summary: 3 enterprise customers affected for ~18 minutes, elevated 429 and latency, no data loss. will notify account teams.

Sam T: thanks all. lowering priority now. marking incident resolved at 2071234920 :white_check_mark:
